name: @factbag/jev
description: Lazy AI-assisted classification and evidence resolution for Factbag.

scripts.api-report: api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.classifier.json && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.errors.json && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.resolve.json && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.staged.json
scripts.api-report:check: api-extractor run --config api-extractor.classifier.json && api-extractor run --config api-extractor.errors.json && api-extractor run --config api-extractor.resolve.json && api-extractor run --config api-extractor.staged.json
scripts.build: node ../../scripts/clean-output.ts dist && tsup src/classifier.ts src/errors.ts src/resolve.ts src/staged.ts --format esm --target node22 --platform node --splitting --sourcemap --out-dir dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node ../../scripts/fix-declaration-specifiers.ts dist
